entries.name: Azelaprag / BGE-105
entries.stage: Phase 2 STRIDES terminated; azelaprag development discontinued
entries.summary: BioAge discontinued dosing and enrolment in the STRIDES Phase 2 obesity study on 6 December 2024 after liver transaminitis without clinically significant symptoms was observed in 11 of 204 enrolled participants in azelaprag groups. The sponsor-submitted registry records the study as terminated with an actual 12 February 2025 completion, and BioAge's later annual filing says development of azelaprag was terminated in January 2025.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for azelaprag, alone or with tirzepatide.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established. A terminated research programme is not an NHS treatment option.
entries.supply: The reviewed evidence does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The safety observation and counts are sponsor and sponsor-submitted registry reports; this summary does not independently determine causation, incidence beyond the studied regimens or risk for other APJ agonists. The registry has no posted results, so efficacy, body-composition and muscle-preservation outcomes are not claimed. The absence of clinically significant symptoms in the sponsor report does not make the laboratory finding clinically unimportant. Azelaprag's termination must not be presented as an active programme, approved medicine, recommended combination or evidence about tirzepatide used alone.

lifecycle.title: A Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Arm Proof-of-Concept Study to Investigate Efficacy and Safety of Oral Azelaprag Plus Once Weekly Tirzepatide Compared with Tirzepatide Alone in Participants with Obesity Aged 55 Years and Over (STRIDES)
lifecycle.whyStopped: Dosing of both study drugs has been discontinued due to observation of liver transaminitis without clinically significant symptoms in some subjects receiving azelaprag. All participant visits have been completed.

sourceReviews.outcome: Complete sponsor announcement read for the discontinued study, 204 enrolled participants, 11 azelaprag-group laboratory observations, stopped dosing and enrolment, and ongoing off-drug follow-up at the announcement date.
